dmca.title: DMCA & Copyright
dmca.subtitle: Copyright policy, takedown guidance, and designated contact.
dmca.noSearchResults: No policy sections match that search.
dmca.noFaqResults: No FAQ items match that search.
dmca.contactCardDesc: Send complete copyright and takedown notices here. Do not use this address for general support — those messages will not be answered here.
dmca.contactSubjectHint: Use the subject line “DMCA Takedown Request” and include every required checklist item.
dmca.overviewLead: AniKitty does not host, upload, store, or encode any video files on its own servers. AniKitty is an index that links to and embeds media hosted by independent third-party providers. We have no control over the files stored on those external services.
dmca.overviewBody: Even so, we take copyright seriously and will act on valid notices as described on this page. Use the sections below for what AniKitty displays, how to file a complete notice, timelines, counter-notices, and FAQ.
dmca.whatWeHostIntro: Understanding what appears on AniKitty helps you file a useful notice. Report specific AniKitty URLs when material accessible through the site allegedly infringes your copyright.
dmca.whatWeHostNote: AniKitty does not control third-party file hosts. A valid notice helps us remove or disable access to identified links on AniKitty and, where applicable, forward the request upstream. Catalog metadata alone (title names, synopses, scores) is usually not enough without URLs that identify the material.
dmca.policyP1: If you are a copyright owner (or an agent authorized to act on their behalf) and believe that material accessible through AniKitty infringes your copyright, you may submit a written notice by email to our designated copyright contact.
dmca.policyP2: To be actionable, your notice must include the required elements listed in How to submit. We review complete notices, verify them on their face, then remove or disable access to the identified links on AniKitty as soon as we are reasonably able.
dmca.policyMisuse: Submitting false or bad-faith takedown notices may carry legal liability. Only the copyright owner or an authorized agent should file a notice.
dmca.submitIntro: Follow these steps and complete the checklist. Incomplete notices may be delayed or cannot be processed.
dmca.processingNote: Because AniKitty only links to files hosted by external third parties, resolving a request often depends on those upstream providers, who we do not control. As a result, action on a valid takedown request may take anywhere from 1 to 6 months to complete. We appreciate your patience.
dmca.counterIntro: If you believe your content was removed in error, you may reply to the same copyright contact address with a counter-notice explaining why, along with your contact details and signature.
dmca.repeatP1: AniKitty may suspend or terminate accounts that repeatedly post infringing user-generated content (such as comments, forum posts, chat messages, or profile materials) when we become aware of a pattern of infringement under appropriate circumstances.
dmca.repeatP2: This policy applies to content users upload or post on AniKitty. It does not mean AniKitty hosts third-party video files; stream sources remain on independent providers outside our control.

rules.title: Comment community rules
rules.intro: Before you post, please read and follow these rules. They keep discussions fun and safe for everyone.
rules.agreeLabel: I have read and agree to follow these community rules.

items.spoilers: Mark spoilers with the Spoiler button. Don't reveal plot twists, endings, or future events without tagging them.
items.respect: Be respectful. Harassment, hate speech, slurs, and personal attacks are not allowed.
items.nsfw: No NSFW content — sexual, overly graphic, or inappropriate material is not allowed in comments or GIFs.
items.spam: No spam, ads, scam links, or off-topic flooding. Keep comments about the anime and episode.
items.moderation: Moderators may remove comments or restrict accounts that break these rules.

donate.title: Support AniKitty
donate.subtitle: Optional tips keep the lights on. €4 on Ko-fi with your @username = 1 month donator rank.
donate.body: AniKitty stays free and ad-free for everyone. Tip €4 (or any amount) on Ko-fi with your @username to unlock 1 month of donator rank per €4.
donate.badgePreviewDesc: €4 ≈ 30 days of donator rank — badge on your profile and comments.
donate.donationDesc: Include your AniKitty @username in the Ko-fi message. €4 → 30 days donator, €8 → 60 days, €2 → 15 days. Stacks if you tip again before it expires.
donate.claimSignIn: Sign in to activate your donator rank.
donate.claimSuccess: Donator unlocked for {days} days — thank you for supporting AniKitty!
donate.claimNotFound: No matching Ko-fi tip found yet. Include your @username in the Ko-fi message, wait a minute, then try again or DM @fampep.
donate.claimFeedUnavailable: Auto-activation is temporarily unavailable — DM @fampep and we will help manually.
donate.claimAmountTooSmall: That tip is too small to activate donator rank.
donate.claimFailed: Could not activate donator. Try again or DM @fampep.

steps.pay: Tip on Ko-fi (€4 = 1 month). Put {username} in the Ko-fi message field.
steps.dm: Send @{username} a DM containing {mention} — or tap Activate donator on this page.
steps.auto: We match recent Ko-fi tips and grant donator days from the amount (€4 → 30 days).
steps.help: Something wrong? DM @{username} and we will sort it out manually.

donate.activeDonator: Your tip is active — you have the donator rank. Thank you!
donate.faqDonatorA: Every €4 with your @username in the Ko-fi message = about 30 days of donator rank (badge on your profile and comments). €8 ≈ 60 days, and so on. The site stays free and ad-free either way.
donate.faqKoFiA: Tip on Ko-fi (ko-fi.com/fampep) with your @username in the message, then tap Activate donator on this page or DM @fampep. We match recent tips automatically when possible.
donate.faqVoluntaryA: No. Watching stays free. Tips are optional — €4 unlocks 1 month of donator rank if you want it.

free.label: Free to watch
free.footnote: No credit card required. Tip only if you want to support the site.

tip.desc: Help cover servers and subtitles. €4 with your @username = ~30 days of donator rank.
